meta.notes: Adapted from data/seed/rare_graph.json (written by pipeline/build_graph.py; 93 diseases) by scripts/seed-to-graph.ts. Edges from the seed carry the pipeline's retrieval date (2026-10-03); Reactome edges carry the release date of Reactome 97 (2026-06-30). Papers, grants and patient groups are search or directory matches and are marked inferred. Phenotype labels are from HPO (2026-09-01); every seed label already matched. Symptoms are partial: pipeline/build_graph.py keeps a disease's Monarch phenotypes only where they are shared inside a Monarch cluster (the same gene, or a shared parent), so 31 of 93 diseases have none on record, and 7 pairs of diseases list identical symptoms; clinical resemblance inside a cluster is overstated and elsewhere understated. Variants are recorded per gene (the first 3 pathogenic ClinVar records of each gene, pipeline/build_graph.py), not per disease. Mechanisms: 221 Reactome pathways (release 97; lowest-level human pathways with at most 300 entities, data/reference/reactome-pathways.json) for 43 of 52 genes; Reactome has no such pathway for AP3D1, FREM2, LMX1B, LYST, OPA3, SIX6, SLC38A8, SLC4A11, TACSTD2, so 12 diseases have no mechanism on record. Skipped: 55 same_gene edges (4 with an endpoint missing from the seed): two diseases that share a Gene node already state it; 20 subclass_of edges: a MONDO category, and the atlas does not group diseases by category; 1 disease_group node (MONDO:0019290). Left out 94 Orphanet directory results whose name match rests only on a generic word of the disease name ("disease" 38, "syndrome" 32, "with" 14, "form" 6, "disability" 2, "finnish" 1, "hereditary" 1): pipeline/build_graph.py keeps a result when the group's name contains any word of the disease name, so such a word attaches a general support group to every disease whose name contains it; 27 patient groups left with no disease are not in the graph. No grant names a principal investigator, so there are no Investigator nodes.
